# ChosePayments

> ChosePayments is an independent payment advisory that helps US businesses find, compare and switch payment processors. It explains how processors price, underwrite and monitor merchants, and matches businesses with providers that are likely to accept them.

Key points about the site:

- The free assessment asks five questions and suggests payment providers suited to a business's model, volume and risk profile.
- The free statement review gives an indicative read on a business's all-in effective rate.
- Articles focus on what merchants actually pay, why accounts get frozen or rejected, and how to choose or switch a processor.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://chosepayments.com/): What ChosePayments does and how the matching works
- [Payment provider assessment](https://chosepayments.com/assessment): Five questions to find which payment providers will accept your business
- [Free statement review](https://chosepayments.com/statement-review): Upload a processing statement to see if you are overpaying
- [About](https://chosepayments.com/about): Why ChosePayments is an advisory, not a comparison site
- [FAQ](https://chosepayments.com/faq): How ChosePayments works, how it makes money and how matching works
- [All insights](https://chosepayments.com/insights): Index of every guide and article
